shared_elements: patterned surface detail on bodies (incised/textured infill)
justification: Both depict human figures holding objects and both use dense incised patterning as surface infill on bodies, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A is a single large near-frontal standing figure with raised arm, arm bands and a sash, seen almost in the round, whereas B is a frieze of small profile figures leading horned rams past a tree in a repeating processional register — different subject, viewpoint, and organisation entirely.
